response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is an experienced senior developer with a strong background in full-stack development, but his seniority and extensive experience may not align well with the junior/mid-level role. His skills in TypeScript, React, and databases are relevant, but his overqualification and focus on advanced topics like AI and Kubernetes could make him a less ideal fit for an entry-level position.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js.
Strong open-source contributions and leadership in technical projects (e.g., GISCollective).
Proven ability to work across multiple domains (web, mobile, embedded) and integrate diverse technologies.
concerns: Overqualified for a junior/mid-level role; may seek more senior responsibilities.
Limited explicit mention of PostgreSQL or Nest.js, which are preferred in the job description.
High on-site presence requirement may conflict with potential flexibility expectations due to seniority.
